Fact: training_method
What to find: Main stages and methods of training (pretraining, SFT, preference optimisation/DPO, RL, distillation, merging).
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Training Procedure, Post-training

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Pretraining on ~40 trillion tokens of multimodal data (Llama 4 Scout), followed by safety fine-tuning using human-generated and synthetic data. Architecture is auto-regressive MoE with early fusion. The card does not detail SFT, DPO, RL, distillation or merging stages.
quotes: Llama 4 Scout was pretrained on ~40 trillion tokens and Llama 4 Maverick was pretrained on ~22 trillion tokens of multimodal data
The primary objective of conducting safety fine-tuning is to offer developers a readily available, safe, and powerful model for various applications
We employ a multi-faceted approach to data collection, combining human-generated data from our vendors with synthetic data to mitigate potential safety risks.
The Llama 4 models are auto-regressive language models that use a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture and incorporate early fusion for native multimodality.
